# genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits_workplanrotation (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud workforce management management unit work plan rotation: an ordered pattern of work plans that rotates weekly, with the agents that follow it. An agent can only be in one work plan rotation, so adding an agent to this rotation removes them from their current one.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits)
* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits/{managementUnitId}/workplanrotations](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits--managementUnitId--workplanrotations)
* [POST /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits/{managementUnitId}/workplanrotations](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#post-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits--managementUnitId--workplanrotations)
* [DELETE /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits/{managementUnitId}/workplanrotations/{workPlanRotationId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#delete-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits--managementUnitId--workplanrotations--workPlanRotationId-)
* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits/{managementUnitId}/workplanrotations/{workPlanRotationId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits--managementUnitId--workplanrotations--workPlanRotationId-)
* [PATCH /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits/{managementUnitId}/workplanrotations/{workPlanRotationId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#patch-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits--managementUnitId--workplanrotations--workPlanRotationId-)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `wfm:agent:view`
* `wfm:workPlanRotation:add`
* `wfm:workPlanRotation:delete`
* `wfm:workPlanRotation:edit`
* `wfm:workPlanRotation:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `workforce-management`
* `workforce-management:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits_workplanrotation" "weekly_rotation" {
  management_unit_id = genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits.contact_center.id
  name               = "Weekly Rotation"
  start_date         = "2026-01-05"
  end_date           = "2026-12-28"

  # The work plans of the pattern rotate weekly, in this order
  work_plan_ids = [
    genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits_workplan.weekday_support.id,
  ]

  agents {
    user_id    = genesyscloud_user.example_user.id
    start_date = "2026-01-05"
    position   = 0
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `management_unit_id` (String) The id of the management unit this work plan rotation belongs to. Changing this attribute will cause the work plan rotation to be dropped and recreated.
- `name` (String) The name of the work plan rotation. Names must be unique within a management unit.
- `start_date` (String) The first date in the business unit's time zone on which the work plan rotation applies, in the format yyyy-MM-dd.
- `work_plan_ids` (List of String) The ids of the work plans of the pattern, in the order in which they rotate weekly. Every work plan must be enabled, and a work plan that is used here cannot be disabled or deleted.

### Optional

- `agents` (Block Set) The agents that follow this work plan rotation. This is authoritative for the work plan rotation: agents in it that are not listed are removed. An agent can only be in one work plan rotation, so listing an agent here removes them from their current rotation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--agents))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the work plan rotation is enabled for scheduling. Genesys Cloud always creates a work plan rotation enabled, so creating one that is disabled takes a second request.
- `end_date` (String) The last date in the business unit's time zone on which the work plan rotation applies, in the format yyyy-MM-dd. Leave it out for an open ended work plan rotation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Required:

- `position` (Number) The start position of the agent in the pattern of the rotation. Positions start at 0, which is the first work plan of the pattern.
- `start_date` (String) The first date in the business unit's time zone on which the agent follows the rotation, in the format yyyy-MM-dd.
- `user_id` (String) The id of an agent in this work plan rotation.

Optional:

- `end_date` (String) The last date in the business unit's time zone on which the agent follows the rotation, in the format yyyy-MM-dd. Leave it out for an open ended date range.
